server_arguments.name: text_only
server_arguments.label: text-only
server_arguments.desc: Use thinker-only pipeline (1 GPU, no talker/speech output).

server_arguments.name: enable_realtime
server_arguments.label: enable-realtime
server_arguments.desc: Mount the OpenAI Realtime WebSocket endpoint at /v1/realtime.

server_arguments.name: mem_fraction_static
server_arguments.label: mem-fraction-static
server_arguments.desc: Set SGLang mem_fraction_static for supported SGLang AR stages. If omitted, SGLang chooses the value automatically.

server_arguments.name: thinker_mem_fraction_static
server_arguments.label: thinker-mem-fraction-static
server_arguments.desc: Set SGLang mem_fraction_static for the thinker stage. Overrides --mem-fraction-static for thinker.

server_arguments.name: talker_mem_fraction_static
server_arguments.label: talker-mem-fraction-static
server_arguments.desc: Set SGLang mem_fraction_static for supported talker AR stages. Overrides --mem-fraction-static for talker.

server_arguments.name: encoder_mem_reserve
server_arguments.label: encoder-mem-reserve
server_arguments.desc: Subtract this fraction from SGLang's auto-picked Qwen thinker mem_fraction_static for colocated external encoders. Valid only when thinker mem_fraction_static is not explicitly pinned. Mutually exclusive with --mem-fraction-static and --thinker-mem-fraction-static.

server_arguments.name: cpu_offload_gb
server_arguments.label: cpu-offload-gb
server_arguments.desc: Set SGLang cpu_offload_gb for the thinker stage.

server_arguments.name: quantization
server_arguments.label: quantization
server_arguments.desc: Set SGLang quantization mode for the thinker stage.

server_arguments.name: thinker_cuda_graph
server_arguments.label: thinker-cuda-graph
server_arguments.desc: CUDA graph mode for thinker stage: default|on|off.

server_arguments.name: talker_cuda_graph
server_arguments.label: talker-cuda-graph
server_arguments.desc: CUDA graph mode for supported SGLang talker stage: default|on|off.

server_arguments.name: talker_partial_start
server_arguments.label: talker-partial-start
server_arguments.desc: Partial-start mode for the Qwen3-Omni talker stage: default|on|off. When on, the talker begins audio generation from a partial thinker text stream instead of waiting for the full text. 'default' uses the pipeline config default.

server_arguments.name: thinker_torch_compile
server_arguments.label: thinker-torch-compile
server_arguments.desc: torch.compile mode for thinker stage: default|on|off.

server_arguments.name: talker_torch_compile
server_arguments.label: talker-torch-compile
server_arguments.desc: torch.compile mode for supported SGLang talker stage: default|on|off.

server_arguments.name: talker_torch_compile_max_bs
server_arguments.label: talker-torch-compile-max-bs
server_arguments.desc: Override torch_compile_max_bs for supported SGLang talker stage.

server_arguments.name: async_decode
server_arguments.label: async-decode
server_arguments.desc: One-step-lookahead async decode for the tts_engine stage: default|on|off. When on, per-step host collect overlaps the next GPU forward. 'default' uses the pipeline config default (on for Higgs TTS). Currently supported by Higgs TTS.

server_arguments.name: async_decode_min_batch_size
server_arguments.label: async-decode-min-batch-size
server_arguments.desc: Decode batches smaller than this bypass the async-decode lookahead and run synchronously (fast path). Default 2.

arguments.name: temperature
arguments.label: temperature
arguments.desc: Sampling temperature. Higher values make output more random, lower values more focused and deterministic.

arguments.name: top_p
arguments.label: top_p
arguments.desc: Nucleus sampling: the model considers only the tokens comprising the top_p probability mass.

arguments.name: top_k
arguments.label: top_k
arguments.desc: Number of highest-probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k filtering. -1 disables top-k.

arguments.name: min_p
arguments.label: min_p
arguments.desc: Minimum token probability, scaled by the probability of the most likely token. Tokens below this are filtered out.

arguments.name: repetition_penalty
arguments.label: repetition_penalty
arguments.desc: Penalizes repeated tokens. Values above 1.0 discourage repetition; 1.0 disables the penalty.

arguments.name: max_tokens
arguments.label: max_tokens
arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. Aliased by max_completion_tokens.

arguments.name: stop
arguments.label: stop_sequences
arguments.desc: Sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

arguments.name: seed
arguments.label: seed
arguments.desc: Random seed for reproducible sampling.
